description: Record a callback request for the Kareverse team. The result contains a WhatsApp link the person must open and send to confirm; Kareverse only contacts people who confirm. Use only after the person has seen Kareverse's privacy notice (https://www.kareverse.com/privacy), explicitly agreed to be contacted, and given their OWN name and phone number; set consent to true to confirm that. Never use it for someone else's number or for emergencies. May be temporarily unavailable.

consent.description: True only if the person saw the privacy notice and agreed that Kareverse may contact them about this enquiry.

message.description: Short background, in the person's words.

name.description: Name of the person Kareverse should contact.

parent_area.description: Where the parent lives in Bangalore.

phone.description: Their phone or WhatsApp number, with country code (e.g. +91 98765 43210 or +1 415 555 0100).

service_interest.description: What they need, e.g. 'Care Plan', 'Hospital accompaniment', 'Night caretaker'.

name: submit_enquiry
title: Request a callback from Kareverse
